name: ACA NeoGeo Selection Vol. 3
summary:
A collection of Arcade Archives NEOGEO releases for the Nintendo Switch.

This package contains:
3 Count Bout
Baseball Stars 2
Blazing Star
Fatal Fury: King of Fighters
The King of Fighters 96
Last Resort
Ninja Combat
Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood
Sengoku
World Heroes Perfect
